title: NHK Special — AIが変える日本社会 (AI Transforming Japanese Society)
description: NHK Special documentary on how artificial intelligence is reshaping Japan — from factory automation and medical diagnosis to generative AI tools entering the workplace. Examines concerns about job displacement alongside optimism about AI solving Japan's labour shortage. Includes interviews with researchers, business leaders, and workers affected by automation. N2–N3 formal Japanese.
creator: NHK Special (NHKスペシャル)
